result.title: Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating Robustness of Sentiment Analysis Models
result.summary: Machine learning systems are challenging to test using traditional software testing methods because their behavior is learned from data rather than explicitly programmed. This challenge is particularly significant in natural language processing (NLP), where small input variations can lead to unexpected model behavior. Conventional evaluation metrics, such as accuracy and F1-score, often fail to capture such inconsistencies. Metamorphic testing addresses this limitation by evaluating expected relationships between original and transformed inputs. With the increasing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and language-based AI systems, the need for systematic robustness testing has become even more pronounced. Motivated by this growing need, this paper presents a lightweight, batch-based metamorphic testing approach for evaluating the robustness of such systems. In particular, we consider sentiment analysis as a representative NLP task and evaluate a pretrained classifier under four transformations: synonym replacement, typo injection, word-order variation, and negation. Using consistency score, flip accuracy, and confidence change, we identify strengths in handling semantic variations and vulnerabilities to textual noise and logical transformations. These findings highlight the value of metamorphic testing in identifying behavioral inconsistencies beyond conventional performance metrics and demonstrate its potential as a systematic framework for evaluating the robustness of language-based AI systems and guiding performance improvements before deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种轻量、批处理的蜕变测试方法，在情感分析任务上对预训练分类器施加同义替换、拼写错误注入、词序变化和否定四种变换，用一致性分数、翻转正确率与置信度变化评估鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对输入施加受控变换后检查输出关系与置信度漂移」的评测思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节扰动、证据筛选及 latent 表示一致性诊断的因果作用验证。
